data_source_reference: IBM Telco Customer Churn sample dataset (public sample data distributed by IBM for Cognos Analytics / commonly mirrored on Kaggle as 'telco-customer-churn').

columns.name: customerID
columns.description: Unique customer identifier with format 'NNNN-XXXX' (digits + 5 alphanumeric characters). One per customer.
columns.feature_reason: 100% unique per row: zero predictive value. Exclude from features; use only as a join key / traceability ID.

columns.name: gender
columns.description: Customer gender (Male / Female).
columns.feature_reason: Standard demographic segmentation variable.

columns.name: SeniorCitizen
columns.description: Binary flag marking customers aged 65+ (1 = senior, 0 = not). Numeric encoding of a boolean.
columns.feature_reason: Age segment proxy; useful for demographic targeting of retention offers.

columns.name: Partner
columns.description: Whether the customer has a spouse/partner (Yes/No).
columns.feature_reason: Household-size proxy; multi-person households churn less in telecom.

columns.name: Dependents
columns.description: Whether the customer has dependents in the household (Yes/No).
columns.feature_reason: Family bundle indicator; correlates with plan choice and stickiness.

columns.name: tenure
columns.description: Customer tenure with the company in completed months (0 = brand new, max 72). Integer.
columns.feature_reason: Strong behavioural variable: contract age at the snapshot date.
columns.target_note: Conceivable as a retention-duration outcome (regression / survival analysis), but weaker direct business actionability; to be evaluated in Phase 3.
columns.leakage_risk: None for churn-style prediction: tenure at scoring time is known. Perfectly collinear with TotalCharges accumulation.

columns.name: PhoneService
columns.description: Whether the customer subscribes to home phone service (Yes/No).
columns.feature_reason: Product-mix variable.

columns.name: MultipleLines
columns.description: Phone add-on: multiple lines (Yes / No / No phone service). The 'No phone service' value encodes the structural dependency on PhoneService.
columns.feature_reason: Product-mix variable with explicit structural category.

columns.name: InternetService
columns.description: Internet technology: DSL, Fiber optic, or No internet service.
columns.feature_reason: Core product line; largest monthly-charge differentiator (median $91.68 fiber vs $56.15 DSL).

columns.name: OnlineSecurity
columns.description: Internet add-on: online security (Yes / No / No internet service).
columns.feature_reason: Value-added service; retention-relevant add-on.

columns.name: OnlineBackup
columns.description: Internet add-on: cloud backup (Yes / No / No internet service).
columns.feature_reason: Value-added service; retention-relevant add-on.

columns.name: DeviceProtection
columns.description: Internet add-on: device protection plan (Yes / No / No internet service).
columns.feature_reason: Value-added service; retention-relevant add-on.

columns.name: TechSupport
columns.description: Internet add-on: tech support plan (Yes / No / No internet service).
columns.feature_reason: Service-quality proxy; retention-relevant add-on.

columns.name: StreamingTV
columns.description: Entertainment add-on: streaming TV (Yes / No / No internet service).
columns.feature_reason: Engagement/entertainment bundle variable.

columns.name: StreamingMovies
columns.description: Entertainment add-on: streaming movies (Yes / No / No internet service).
columns.feature_reason: Engagement/entertainment bundle variable.

columns.name: Contract
columns.description: Contract type: Month-to-month, One year, or Two year. Defines the customer's commitment period and exit cost.
columns.feature_reason: Strongest commitment/switching-cost variable in the dataset; 55% of the base is month-to-month.
columns.leakage_risk: None. Contract type is known at any scoring time.

columns.name: PaperlessBilling
columns.description: Whether the customer receives paperless billing (Yes/No).
columns.feature_reason: Billing-behaviour variable; interacts with payment method.

columns.name: PaymentMethod
columns.description: Payment method: Electronic check, Mailed check, Bank transfer (automatic), or Credit card (automatic).
columns.feature_reason: Distinguishes manual vs automatic payments - a known friction/retention lever.

columns.name: MonthlyCharges
columns.description: Recurring monthly charge for the customer's current bundle, in USD. Range $18.25-$118.75.
columns.feature_reason: Core price variable; price-sensitivity analyses.
columns.target_note: Could serve as a price/ARPU regression outcome, but weak business actionability as a target; to be evaluated in Phase 3.
columns.leakage_risk: None. Known for any active customer at scoring time.

columns.name: TotalCharges
columns.description: Cumulative amount billed to the customer to date, in USD. Stored as text with 11 blank strings (all tenure = 0 customers). Range $18.80-$8,684.80, right-skewed.
columns.feature_reason: Lifetime revenue proxy. Requires cleaning (numeric coercion + imputation of 11 blanks, e.g. tenure x MonthlyCharges).
columns.target_note: Candidate for a customer-value / revenue regression, but weak actionability as a direct target; to be evaluated in Phase 3.
columns.leakage_risk: Temporal-proxy risk: TotalCharges accumulates over tenure and is approximately tenure x MonthlyCharges, so it partially encodes tenure. It is available at scoring time for existing customers, but a model relying on it would not generalise to brand-new customers. Check collinearity before use.

columns.name: Churn
columns.description: Outcome flag: whether the customer left the company within the observation window (Yes = churned, 26.54%; No = retained, 73.46%).
columns.feature_reason: It is the only outcome-like flag in the dataset. If it were used as a feature for any model, it would leak the very outcome being predicted. Must be excluded from feature matrices.
columns.target_note: Only outcome-like flag in the dataset; natural candidate-target for retention problems. Selection/ranking belongs to Phase 3 - no decision is made here.
columns.leakage_risk: It IS the outcome. Using it as a feature would be target leakage; predicting it is the legitimate use, pending Phase 3 approval.

grain: one row = one customer snapshot (demographics, services, contract, billing, churn outcome flag)
